What are exosomes?

Exosomes are vesicles secreted outside cells, and their particularly important role is in the transmission of information between cells.
These exosomes have a bag-like structure and contain important information related to genes, such as nucleic acids (microRNA and messenger RNA) and proteins.

It has been shown that recipient cells that receive exosomes undergo changes in their physiological functions and functions, and specific changes have been confirmed to include activation of stem cells throughout the body, promotion of excellent skin regeneration and blood vessel regeneration, and multiple anti-inflammatory effects.

What are stem cells?

Stem cells stimulated by exosome activation refer to cells with two major abilities: the ability to differentiate into diverse cells and the ability to self-renew cells of the same type.
The human body is made up of a wide variety of cell types, including skin cells, nerve cells, and blood cells.
Skin cells do not transform into nerve cells, but stem cells are special cells that can transform not only into skin cells but also into nerve cells.
Among these, pluripotent stem cells such as ES cells and iPS cells, which are attracting attention in the field of regenerative medicine, have the ability to differentiate into all types of cells. On the other hand, somatic stem cells have the characteristic of being restricted to cells that can differentiate within a certain range, such as nerves, blood, and muscles.

Exosomes are attracting attention, especially in terms of activating somatic stem cells, and their ability is being studied.

This treatment is recommended for those who suffer from the following problems:

  • Those who want to prevent aging
  • Those who wish to rejuvenate their entire body
  • People who want their skin to feel firm and shiny
  • Those who want to improve spots, wrinkles, and dullness
  • Those who are concerned about thinning hair
  • Those who want firmness and body to their hair
  • Those who want to improve their immunity
  • Those who are worried about menopausal symptoms

Characteristics and effects of exosome therapy

  • Rejuvenation at the cellular level
  • Regenerate skin scars
  • Strengthens the skin and keeps it moisturized
  • whitening
  • treatment of thinning hair
  • Improvement of ED
  • Improving forgetfulness

Various growth factors contained in exosomes

EGF（Epidermal Growth Factor）

It stimulates the growth of skin cells and activates skin turnover, and is expected to improve age spots and dullness.

IGF（Insulin-like Growth Factor）

Promotes the production of collagen, elastin, hyaluronic acid, etc., giving elasticity to the skin.

TGF-β（Transforming Growth Factor Beta）

It promotes the proliferation of fibroblasts, etc., and is expected to have anti-inflammatory effects and improve sensitive skin.

PDGF（Platelet-Derived Growth Factor）

It has a tissue repair effect and promotes collagen production.

HGF（Hepatocyte Growth Factor）

In addition to liver cells, it has an anti-aging effect on all cells and supports tissue regeneration and repair.

VEGF（Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor）

It has the effect of improving blood flow and is expected to promote hair growth and growth.

FGF（Fibroblast Growth Factor）

Stimulates tissue repair and the production of collagen and hyaluronic acid, providing elasticity and moisture to the skin.

KGF（Keratinocyte Growth Factor）

It stimulates hair growth and hair growth by promoting the activation of hair matrix cells.

About our hospital's exosome therapy

Exosome drip

Exosome drip (concentrated fat-derived stem cell culture supernatant) is an innovative treatment method that is attracting attention not only in the field of aesthetic medicine but also in the field of regenerative medicine. Stem cell culture supernatant used for exosome infusion refers to the liquid part obtained during the process of culturing stem cells, and contains many components such as cytokines (growth factors), amino acids, vitamins, and minerals that are beneficial for beauty, health, and anti-aging. In particular, cytokines (growth factors) contain many information transmitters that promote cell growth and repair, and play a role in activating cell functions.

There are various types of stem cell culture supernatant, such as fat-derived and dental pulp-derived, but at our hospital, we consider the characteristics and effects of each, and select and use human adipose-derived stem cell culture supernatant, human amniotic fluid-derived stem cell culture supernatant, etc. according to the treatment method.

exosome injection

Exosome injection is a treatment that is expected to improve skin beauty and promote skin regeneration, and uses stem cell culture supernatant. Exosomes are intercellular communication molecules secreted by cells, and are expected to stimulate turnover, regenerate the skin, and have antioxidant effects. When injected under the skin, it is expected to improve skin problems such as age spots, dullness, fine wrinkles, acne, enlarged pores, atopic dermatitis, and dryness. In addition, exosome injection into the scalp is expected to have the effect of hair growth and thickening.
At our hospital, we use water light injections that incorporate exosomes.

About the safety of exosomes

About the culture processing facility

Commercialized at the cell culture processing facility of a specified processed cell manufacturer
・Sterilization is carried out using clean rooms and filtering.
・Manufactured in a strictly controlled facility
・Culture in serum-free medium

Product safety testing, etc.

・Safety has been confirmed in the following tests.
Intradermal reaction test, skin sensitization test, acute systemic toxicity test, repeated systemic toxicity test
Primary skin irritation test, antigenicity test, continuous skin irritation test

Why choose our hospital's exosome therapy?

Tailor-made treatment tailored to each patient's concerns

At our hospital, we first pay close attention to the concerns and requests of our patients, and carefully propose treatment methods that are suitable for each individual patient.

Total support

Our hospital takes the utmost care to protect personal information so that patients can receive treatment with peace of mind. Our doctors, nurses, and staff will do their best to ensure your satisfaction at every step, from consultation to treatment to aftercare.

Treatment by experienced doctors

Doctors with extensive experience are always striving to acquire the latest knowledge and techniques, and we promise to provide techniques that will satisfy our patients.

Flow of treatment

STEP1

We will provide counseling. We will listen to your concerns and assess the current state of your skin. We will check whether you have any allergies and decide whether the treatment is appropriate for you.

STEP2

Before your treatment, you will be asked to remove your makeup. Makeup remover and facial cleanser are available at our clinic, so you can use them.

STEP3

Anesthesia will be administered upon request.

STEP4

We will administer exosome drips and injections. The treatment time is approximately 30 minutes per session.

STEP5

In order to maximize the effectiveness of the drug, please avoid washing your face, using lotions, lotions, etc. for approximately 6 hours after surgery.

Risks and side effects

In rare cases, a lump, pain, skin discoloration, or itching may occur at the injection site. These symptoms usually subside within 1 to 2 weeks after surgery.
Since exosomes use human-derived components, you will not be able to donate blood after the procedure.

About downtime/post-surgery

Although it varies from person to person, you may experience some redness or petechiae at the injection site after the treatment. In rare cases, symptoms such as swelling and internal bleeding may occur, but the condition will stabilize over time.

Frequently asked questions

When will it start to take effect?

In order to fully experience the effects, we usually recommend 3 injections every 1 to 2 weeks. Especially in the case of AGA and hair thinning treatments, it is difficult to experience immediate effects with a single treatment, and multiple treatments are required. It is generally said that it takes about six months to a year to feel the effects of hair growth.

Are there any side effects?

When exosomes are administered by injection or drip, symptoms such as redness, swelling, and itching may occur, but these symptoms generally subside within 2 to 3 days.

Are there people who cannot receive treatment?

Treatment may not be suitable depending on your history of allergies and current medication status. Treatment may not be suitable for those who are pregnant or breastfeeding, those with drug allergies, or those undergoing treatment for malignant tumors. Please be sure to report and consult your doctor with this information before receiving treatment.

What is the appropriate amount of exosomes for one treatment?

Although a single dose of exosomes of 10cc is not an excessive amount, our hospital recommends administering from 4cc to maximize the effect.
